narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I pulled the training logs for the last three weeks to see how the nightly retraining job starts. The pipeline goes straight from data validation into feature engineering. There is no step between those two that compares the new point of sale scan lines against the historical distribution. I checked the workflow definition and the job scheduler. No script runs a statistical test on the input features before the model fits. The code simply assumes the incoming data looks like the data it was trained on. I watched a run where the fresh produce volume spiked by forty percent due to a local event, and the job proceeded without pausing or flagging the anomaly. It just consumed the rows and updated the weights.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a purely observational report describing the current pipeline's lack of a data drift check and a specific incident where an anomaly went unflagged, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
